title: e2e interactivity oracle: local injectRufflePlayer omits autoplay:'on' (3 false diffPixels=0 failures)
description: RESOLVED (agent-1215). Root cause: interactivity.spec.ts had its OWN local injectRufflePlayer that omitted BOTH (1) autoplay:'on'/unmuteOverlay:'hidden' AND (2) a hideRuffleOverlays() call. Two coupled harness gaps, both confirmed firsthand: (a) without autoplay:'on' the suspended-AudioContext play-button overlay keeps the timeline from ever calling play(); (b) even with autoplay forcing playback, the play-button/hardware-accel panic overlay elements in the player shadow DOM INTERCEPT the synthesized .click() so it never reaches the SWF button hit area -> on(release)/press BUTTONCONDACTION never fires -> diffPixels=0. Proven by empirical means: before fix the stage rendered correctly (red 100x100 center rect, mean 255/243/243) but click produced ZERO change; adding hideRuffleOverlays flipped after-click mean to 243/243/255 (blue = frame advanced). button-roundtrip.spec.ts (identical on(release) fixture) already PASSED because it called hideRuffleOverlays -> confirms harness-not-product. FIX (apps/desktop/e2e/interactivity.spec.ts ONLY, +55/-1): add autoplay:'on'+unmuteOverlay:'hidden' to the load opts; add a hideRuffleOverlays() helper (recursive shadow-DOM display:none!important on id/class matching modal|overlay|message|splash|play-button|panic) and call it after load and after each click/hover, before each screenshot. Did NOT touch the CWS structural byte-parser (inflateSwf/findDefineButton2) owned by task 1214, nor any product code. VERIFY: cd apps/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/interactivity.spec.ts => 6 passed (37.0s) [button release, Up-only HIT_TEST(1196), button press, onClipEvent(load), dot-catcher capstone pixelDiff=10000, button Over hover]. Unit: swf 1386 passed; authoring-ui 653 passed; core 5295 passed / 2-3 fail = ONLY the pre-existing task-1207 missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (allowed). Ruffle assets restored to apps/desktop/public/ruffle from @ruffle-rs/ruffle 0.2.0 (gitignored). Docs: CLAUDE.md learning added under SWF clip actions.
